remarks: Welcome to this beautifully appointed 3360 sq ft Colonial in a fabulous location in the Williamsville School District! Meticulously maintained by its original owners, this 4-bed, 2.5-bath move-in-ready home offers timeless style, thoughtful design & inviting spaces for both everyday living & entertaining. Beautiful curb appeal, lovely gardens, & manicured landscaping welcome you to the covered front porch. Inside, the center-entrance foyer opens to gleaming American cherry hardwood flrs & 9-ft ceilings throughout the main living areas. The formal din room features crown molding & wainscoting & both the formal liv & din rooms showcase beautiful floor-to-ceiling transom windows. French doors in the liv rm lead to the spacious fam room, where a gas fireplace & additional transom windows fill the room w/warmth & natural light. The fam room flows seamlessly into the expansive kit w/timeless cherry cabinetry, quartz perimeter countertops, SS appls & a granite-topped center isle w/breakfast bar. The spacious kitchen/dining area continues the open design & leads to a sun-filled sunroom w/a cathedral ceiling, walls of windows, & sliding door access to the backyard. A private 1st-flr office/den is thoughtfully tucked away, creating the perfect workspace or peaceful retreat. Upstairs, you'll find 4 spacious bedrooms, 2 full baths, a convenient laundry room, & abundant closet space. The primary ensuite features a tray ceiling, a lrg walk-in closet w/a window, & a glamour bath. The LL features 8 ft ceilings, a rec room, & abundant storage. Enjoy the peaceful backyard w/2 patios, including 1 covered patio, w/an additional door providing access to the covered porch. The 2.5-car side-load garage features a drain & utility sink & leads into the mudroom w/built-in cubbies, a storage bench, & a closet. An updated 1/2 bath is conveniently located. Updates include 2 new HWTs '26, AC '25, a new roof '19, & a newer concrete patio & walkway. Soft, neutral paint colors throughout. Ideally located in one of Williamsville's most desirable areas, close to shopping, dining, major roadways, & all the conveniences of daily life. A truly special home offering space, quality, & timeless appeal!
